content.value_statement: Large code changes can hide quality, security, performance, and testing risks. This skill coordinates a phased review workflow that turns those risks into prioritized action.
actual_capabilities: Guides reviews across code quality, architecture, security, performance, testing, documentation, and DevOps practices.
Defines phased prompts for specialized review agents and consolidated reporting.
Supports review options for security focus, performance concerns, TDD review, strict mode, metrics, and frameworks.
Maps findings into critical, high, medium, and low priority groups.
Lists success criteria for complete review outcomes and remediation planning.
limitations: Requires available review agents or manual substitution for each phase.
Does not include executable scanners, integrations, or automation scripts.
Review quality depends on the code context and arguments supplied by the user.
The referenced implementation playbook is not included in this package.

use_cases.title: Pre-release Review
use_cases.description: Run a structured review before merging a major feature or release branch.

use_cases.title: Security-focused Assessment
use_cases.description: Prioritize OWASP, dependency, secrets, authentication, and configuration risks during code review.

use_cases.title: Quality Improvement Planning
use_cases.description: Create a prioritized backlog for architecture, testing, documentation, and DevOps improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Pull Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review the current pull request. Focus on code quality, testing gaps, and clear next steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a focused change

prompt_templates.title: Run Security-first Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use --security-focus to review this service. Prioritize authentication, authorization, input validation, dependency risk, and secrets handling.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Release Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Use strict mode and metrics reporting for this release branch. Include quality, performance, tests, documentation, and deployment concerns.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review before a production release

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Full Architecture Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the complete phased workflow for this repository. Use framework-specific guidance, consolidate agent findings, and produce prioritized remediation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced multi-domain review of a repository

output_examples.input: Review a payment service before release.
output_examples.output: A prioritized report covering security risks, performance concerns, missing tests, architecture issues, and release blockers.

output_examples.input: Check a React application with performance concerns.
output_examples.output: Findings on component patterns, rendering bottlenecks, caching strategy, test coverage, and documentation gaps.
A DevOps review covering build automation, rollback readiness, artifact handling, observability, and pipeline security.

best_practices: Provide the target repository, branch, review goals, and risk areas before starting.
Run focused review phases when time is limited, then consolidate only verified findings.
Convert each accepted finding into an owner, priority, and remediation step.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated review output as proof without checking the referenced code.
Do not run all phases when a small, targeted review would answer the decision.
Do not mix speculative issues with confirmed defects in the same priority group.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews code quality, architecture, security, performance, testing, documentation, and DevOps practices.

faq.question: Does it run scanners automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides review prompts and workflow structure, but does not include executable scanner integrations.

faq.question: Can I focus only on security?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the security focus option to prioritize vulnerabilities, dependency risk, secrets, and access control.

faq.question: Can it review a single pull request?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the pull request context and ask for the phases that match the change size.

faq.question: What tools does it support?
faq.answer: The report declares compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I provide before using it?
faq.answer: Provide the code target, review scope, framework, release urgency, and any known risk areas.
